name: ProcessSteps
description: Ordered process cards with derived step numbers or custom icons.
designIntent: Marketing pages explain a process as 01/02/03 cards. ProcessSteps uses an ordered list so the sequence is structural, derives the numbers from order and supports icons without turning the section into arbitrary divs.

props.name: steps
props.description: Ordered steps: title, optional description and icon.

props.name: numbered
props.description: Show step numbers when no icon is provided.

examples.title: Advisor process
examples.code:
<ProcessSteps
  steps={[
    { title: 'Meet your consultant', description: 'Share your goals.' },
    { title: 'Review advisors', description: 'Compare recommendations.' },
    { title: 'Interview and hire', description: 'Choose with confidence.' },
  ]}
/>

antiPatterns.title: Don't hardcode step numbers
antiPatterns.explanation: Numbers come from the list order. Hardcoded numbers drift when steps are inserted or reordered.

accessibility.implementation: Renders ol/li so the order is announced
accessibility.userRequirements: Keep steps in the intended order

accessibility.implementation: The marker is visual; the list order carries the sequence
accessibility.userRequirements: Provide a title for every step

compositionRules.relationship: Place ProcessSteps inside a Section band
